STATIONARY_ENERGY.methodology_note: Aggregated from 2 GPC subsectors in SEEG Coleção 14.0 (GWP-AR5).

subsectors.data_source: SEEG Municípios Coleção 14.0 (GWP-AR5, 2025) — Scope 2 electricity not disaggregated in SEEG Municípios
subsectors.methodology_note: SEEG Municípios allocates power-plant Scope 1 emissions at generation sites rather than municipal end-use Scope 2 electricity. Baseline is 0.0 tCO2e until local MWh consumption is supplied.
subsectors.gap_note: Obtain annual municipal electricity consumption (MWh) by tariff class for São Jorge do Patrocínio from Copel Distribuição / ANEEL SINDAT and apply Brazil SIN grid factor via Local Override to upgrade to T1_LOCAL.

subsectors.methodology_note: State-level ANP/EPE fuel balances (GLP, diesel, fuel oil) disaggregated to municipalities via IBGE population and industrial/commercial value-added proxies.

TRANSPORTATION.methodology_note: Aggregated from 2 GPC subsectors in SEEG Coleção 14.0 (GWP-AR5).

subsectors.subsector_name: On-Road Transportation (Urban Fleet, Freight & Public Transit)
subsectors.data_source: SEEG Municípios Coleção 14.0 (GWP-AR5, 2025) — Energia / Transportes / Rodoviário
subsectors.methodology_note: State/regional ANP fuel distribution (Diesel B14, Gasoline C, Hydrated Ethanol) allocated to municipalities using SENATRAN fleet shares and highway VKT modeling.

subsectors.data_source: SEEG Municípios Coleção 14.0 (GWP-AR5, 2025) — Energia / Transportes (Aéreo, Ferroviário, Hidroviário)
subsectors.methodology_note: Regional aviation kerosene (QAV), aviation gasoline, and rail/waterway diesel allocated by ANAC airport LTO cycles and transport network proxies.
subsectors.gap_note: Obtain local airport QAV fuel uplift records (if applicable) and municipal off-road machinery diesel logs for São Jorge do Patrocínio to upgrade to T1_LOCAL.

WASTE.methodology_note: Aggregated from 2 GPC subsectors in SEEG Coleção 14.0 (GWP-AR5).
WASTE.gap_note: Municipal Solid Waste Disposal & Incineration: Obtain certified municipal landfill weighbridge tonnage (t/year) and active methane capture/flaring logs for São Jorge do Patrocínio to upgrade to T1_LOCAL. | Domestic & Industrial Wastewater Treatment: Obtain Sanepar / municipal ETE plant-level BOD inflow/outflow and biogas flaring logs for São Jorge do Patrocínio to upgrade to T1_LOCAL.

subsectors.data_source: SEEG Municípios Coleção 14.0 (GWP-AR5, 2025) — Resíduos (Disposição final, Incineração, Tratamento biológico)
subsectors.methodology_note: IPCC First-Order Decay (FOD) model driven by SNIS / IBGE per-capita waste generation and regional landfill/dumpsite shares.
subsectors.gap_note: Obtain certified municipal landfill weighbridge tonnage (t/year) and active methane capture/flaring logs for São Jorge do Patrocínio to upgrade to T1_LOCAL.

subsectors.data_source: SEEG Municípios Coleção 14.0 (GWP-AR5, 2025) — Resíduos (Efluentes domésticos e industriais)
subsectors.methodology_note: Estimated from municipal population, SNIS sewage coverage rates, and industrial BOD proxies using IPCC CH4/N2O effluent emission factors.
subsectors.gap_note: Obtain Sanepar / municipal ETE plant-level BOD inflow/outflow and biogas flaring logs for São Jorge do Patrocínio to upgrade to T1_LOCAL.

IPPU.data_source: SEEG Municípios Coleção 14.0 (GWP-AR5, 2025) (Industrial Processes and Product Use)
IPPU.methodology_note: Point-source cement/lime/metallurgy allocation and national HFC/solvent proxies downscaled by municipal industrial registry.

subsectors.methodology_note: Point-source cement/lime/metallurgy allocation and national HFC/solvent proxies downscaled by municipal industrial registry.

subsectors.data_source: SEEG Municípios Coleção 14.0 (GWP-AR5, 2025) — Agropecuária (IBGE PPM/PAM Municipal Modeling)
subsectors.methodology_note: Spatially/census-modeled from IBGE Pesquisa da Pecuária Municipal (PPM) herd counts, PAM crop areas, and Tier 2 IPCC enteric fermentation & soil N2O factors.
subsectors.gap_note: Verify local agricultural cooperative fertilizer sales and manure management practices within São Jorge do Patrocínio to upgrade to T1_LOCAL.

subsectors.data_source: SEEG Municípios Coleção 14.0 (GWP-AR5, 2025) — Mudança de Uso da Terra e Floresta (MapBiomas Spatial Modeling)
subsectors.methodology_note: Spatially modeled at 30m resolution from MapBiomas annual land-cover transition matrices (gross deforestation/soil carbon emissions net of secondary forest & protected-area removals).
subsectors.gap_note: Integrate municipal CAR (Cadastro Ambiental Rural) field-verified forest biomass and urban arborization carbon inventory for São Jorge do Patrocínio to upgrade to T1_LOCAL.
